Message:
KVM: x86: hyperv: optimize 'all cpus' case in kvm_hv_flush_tlb()

We can use 'NULL' to represent 'all cpus' case in
kvm_make_vcpus_request_mask() and avoid building vCPU mask with
all vCPUs.
